notes: Material: 1020 SHEET STL.; title DRIP PAN; model VERT. 90.
Executable geometry represents the clearly depicted formed perimeter wall, not an assumed complete pan with a bottom.
Final envelope: X = D001 + 2*(D003 + D006), Y = D002 + 2*D006, Z = D007. Its minimum corner is the origin.
Top view lies in global XY; wall height is global Z. Front-view hole elevation maps to global z.
Overlapping polygon/circle bosses and through cuts form one continuous annular wall. Refine internal boss faces after union and preserve analytic circular arcs.
The evaluated angle coefficients are tied to D005 = 15° and must be regenerated if D005 changes.
D010, APX. DEVELOPED LGTH. = 85.68, is approximate fabrication information, not an exact profile closure constraint.
Derived extraction dimensions D011 through D015 are not used to override printed controlling dimensions.
No extra flat-transition fillets, seam overlap, welds, drain, or bottom construction have been invented.
General tolerances: two-place ±.02 inch; three-place ±.010 inch; angular ±1°.
